basic_profile.bio: I'm a history enthusiast and avid gamer from Seville, Spain. My main passion is strategy games, especially those focusing on historical settings like Europa Universalis IV. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to engage with communities during various hours, though I'm most active in the late evenings. I'm single, and I enjoy exploring art and philosophy, particularly Jungian concepts. I dislike overly aggressive online debates, preferring constructive discussions. I also have a soft spot for anime and occasionally indulge in discussions about my favorite shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in history from a local university, which fueled my passion for historical strategy games. I've taught myself the intricacies of game mechanics through extensive gameplay and community engagement. My graphic design skills are self-taught, honed over years of freelancing.
